verdict.rationale: Auth0 supports headless/CI automation via the Client Credentials (M2M) flow for machine-to-machine auth, an official CLI for managing tenant config/automation in dev/deploy workflows, and Actions for scripted customization, all of which are usable without a UI. However, evidence is docs-only with no hands-on CI usage reports or pipeline examples. missing for 10: independent/hands-on evidence of CI pipeline integration, CLI usage examples in automation scripts, and confirmation of non-interactive auth flows beyond docs claims.
